newsitem.title: ESTONIA: THREE COMPANIES TO BECOME NEW BOURSE MEMBERS.
newsitem.headline: THREE COMPANIES TO BECOME NEW BOURSE MEMBERS.

text.p: The Tallinn bourse said its board on Friday approved the applications of three companies to become bourse members.
"The board decided to approve the applications of Krediidipank, Beeta Invest and NG Kapital," Helo Meigas, the managing director of the bourse, told Reuters.
"The applications were approved on the condition they will subscribe to the bourse's shares," she added.
The Tallinn stock exchange's share capital is 2.6 million kroons, which will increase by 300,000 kroons, Meigas said.
The decision on the new share issue will be decided by the bourse council, which will not meet before September, she added.
The Tallinn Stock Exchange has 19 members now.
